name: WF5 - Daily 08:00 → Expiring Offers (3 days) → Owners + Admin Summary

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id AS offer_id, o.title, o.end_date, b.id AS business_id, b.name AS business_name,
       u.email AS owner_email, u.first_name AS owner_first_name
FROM offers o
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = o.business_id
JOIN user_businesses ub ON ub.business_id = b.id
JOIN users u ON u.id = ub.user_id
WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
  AND o.end_date = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days'
ORDER BY u.email, o.id;

parameters.text: =📅 *Oferte care expiră pe {{ $json.date }}*: {{ $json.offers }} oferte, {{ $json.owners }} proprietari notificați.
